prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: Travis puppet v2, production 1536x1536 transparent atlas, equal 512px 3x3 cells. IMAGE 1 is an EXACT SHAPE AND POSITION TEMPLATE: color within these silhouettes, retain size, scale and placement. IMAGE 2 is Tristan style target ONLY. Images 3-4 are Travis likeness photos ONLY. Do NOT reproduce previous detailed Travis artwork. Flat vector fills, one or two solid tones per material, NO painted shading, gradients, outlines, texture, glow or soft edges. No text logos watermark or grid. Real alpha transparency. Same fair warm skin on every piece.
ROW1 LEFT HEAD: same size and outline as template, Travis short dark brown hair fuller on top short sides, full neatly trimmed dark brown beard, Travis nose/brow profile and tapered neck. Simplify like Tristan: NO EYE, NO EYEBROW DETAIL, NO MOUTH LINE, NO EAR DETAIL, no hair strands, no smile detail, no sunglasses. Flat solid skin/hair/beard shapes only.
ROW1 MIDDLE TORSO: olive gray-green crew-neck tee with small chest pocket, no logo. Fill solid shoulder, NO ARMHOLE CUTOUT OR SKIN DOT. Remove vest/bottle protrusions on left back and right chest of template for normal average chest/back. Flat stomach, NO BELLY, no wider than Tristan chest. No vest, straps or backpack.
ROW1 RIGHT SHORTS: fill ONLY template rounded HIP PIECE silhouette from waistband to seat. Khaki with belt-loop waistband, optional one pocket seam. NO SHORTS LEG, NO SKIN, no flat cut across seat.
ROW2 LEFT THIGH: preserve exact template shape, khaki shorts leg on top with rounded slightly flared hem, skin below and rounded knee cap. ROW2 MIDDLE SHIN: skin with short dark crew sock at bottom and curved sock top. ROW2 RIGHT SHOE: dark brown hiking shoe gray sole, exact template silhouette, flat side view.
ROW3 LEFT UPPER ARM: olive tee sleeve on top, olive covering round shoulder cap, curved rounded hem, skin below, rounded joint caps. ROW3 MIDDLE NEAR FOREARM: skin, black watch, fist, exact template. ROW3 RIGHT FAR FOREARM: same without watch. All pieces face right. No extra parts or accessories. Every piece fills gray shape, with transparent gaps. Only torso vest bulges should be reduced; never change body to heavy build.

Correct image 1 atlas using image 2 exact gray shape template. FINAL PRODUCTION CANVAS MUST BE 1536x1536 pixels, equal 512px cells. Preserve existing simplified Travis head with no eye, all colors, skin, shoes and watch. TOP MIDDLE: repaint ALL skin below neckline as olive shirt, including the peach triangle under sleeve. Torso should be a single continuous olive shape with only olive pocket and collar, NO attached sleeve or arm, no skin anywhere except tiny neckline at top; separate upper arm is in bottom-left cell. Make torso normal flat stomach, no belly. TOP RIGHT: replace rectangular shorts drawing with template's exact rounded HIP silhouette: KHaki fill from waistband to rounded seat, no legs, no inseam, no skin. Template is the clipping silhouette to match, not a full pair of shorts. Remove vertical center seam/inseam. Preserve exact template shape, position and scale for each part, rounded thigh/sleeve hems. Flat solid color fills only, no gradients shading outlines texture. Everything outside shapes transparent alpha, no flecks halos or glows.

Change only fabric in MIDDLE ROW LEFT cell from OLIVE GREEN to KHAKI TAN matching TOP ROW RIGHT hip piece. This middle-left part is a THIGH wearing khaki shorts, not an arm. Preserve its curved shorts hem and skin below. BOTTOM ROW LEFT is upper arm; its sleeve remains OLIVE GREEN. Leave head, face, solid olive torso, khaki hip silhouette, shin, shoes, forearms, watches and all shapes/positions unchanged. No other changes. Preserve alpha transparency. Exact 1536x1536 canvas requested.
